% Adapted from the documented tkz-euclide tkzInterCC[with nodes] form.
% Each circle supplies a center and two points whose separation is its radius.
\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{tikz}
\usepackage{tkz-euclide}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[scale=.8]
  \tkzDefPoints{0/0/A,4/0/P,5/0/B,8/0/Q}
  \tkzInterCC[with nodes](A,A,P)(B,B,Q)\tkzGetPoints{C}{D}

  \tkzDrawCircle(A,P)
  \tkzDrawCircle(B,Q)
  \tkzDrawSegments[gray](A,C B,C A,D B,D)
  \tkzDrawPoints(A,B,C,D)
  \tkzLabelPoints[below](A,B)
  \tkzLabelPoints[above](C)
  \tkzLabelPoints[below](D)
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
